description: Renewable Energy Capacity Factor Maps (2021) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. Geoscience Australia and Monash University have produced a series of renewable energy capacity factor maps of Australia. Solar photovoltaic, concentrated solar power, wind (150 metre hub height) and hybrid wind and solar capacity factor maps are included in this dataset. All maps are available for download in geotiff format. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are EARTH SCIENCES, ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES, Published_External, capacity factor, renewable energy. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTML, PDF, WCS, WMS, ZIP. The portal shows 2025-10-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
